title: HierSVA: A Data Synthesis Pipeline, Dataset, and Benchmark for LLM-Driven Hierarchical Hardware Formal Verification
authors_zh: Maohua Nie, Jiang Zhu, Jingqun Zhang, Zhichen Zeng, Jiayi Wang, Sibo Zhang, Jialin Wang, C. -J. Richard Shi
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** A six-axis SVA benchmark with 342 hierarchical RTL modules and 28 deep bug pairs.
342 个层级 RTL 模块、28 组深层 bug pair 与六维 SVA 验证 benchmark。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Research on LLM-generated SystemVerilog Assertions often evaluates flat toy modules and checks only syntax or provability, without measuring vacuity, specification faithfulness, bug detection, or coverage of important formal cores in hierarchical designs. Real RTL includes deep instances and parameter dependencies, complicating construction and evaluation.

HierSVA provides a hierarchical RTL preprocessing and assertion-synthesis pipeline, dataset, and six-axis benchmark, using formal tools to separate compilation, proof, and genuine verification value.

LLM 生成 SystemVerilog Assertion 的研究多在扁平小模块上评测，只看语法或是否能证明，无法衡量断言是否空真、忠实覆盖规格、检测 bug 或触及层级设计的关键 formal core。真实 RTL 包含深层实例和参数依赖，使数据构建与评测更困难。

HierSVA 同时提供层级 RTL 预处理与断言合成流程、数据集和六维 benchmark，用形式工具区分“能编译”“能证明”和“真正有验证价值”。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: HierSVA-DS is built from BaseJump STL and contains 342 modules with hierarchy metadata at depths 0–9. It also includes 28 deep module–bug pairs with natural-language specifications and bug variants. Records contain RTL, hierarchy and parameter metadata, reference SVA, specifications, mutations, and tool outputs. HierSVA-B evaluates assertions along syntax, proof success, vacuity, specification faithfulness, mutation coverage, and formal-core coverage. The dataset follows the Solderpad Hardware License v2.1.

HierSVA-DS 基于 BaseJump STL 构建 342 个模块，附层级元数据，深度覆盖 0–9；另含 28 组深层 module–bug pair、自然语言规格和 bug variants。记录包括 RTL、层级/参数信息、参考 SVA、规格、变异和工具输出。HierSVA-B 从 syntax、proof success、vacuity、specification faithfulness、mutation coverage、formal core coverage 六轴评测断言。数据许可遵循 Solderpad Hardware License v2.1。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Preprocess hierarchical RTL: A BaseJump STL commit is pinned, dependencies, parameters, and instances are expanded, and modules are packaged for standalone formal verification.
  1. Synthesize reference assertions: An LLM proposes SVA from RTL and specifications; formal-tool feedback on compilation, proof, and vacuity drives iterative repair before artifacts are stored.
  1. Build deep bug data: Multiple bug types are injected into 28 modules, preserving correct and buggy RTL, natural-language specifications, and mutation lineage.
  1. Run six-axis verification: Compilation checks syntax, formal engines check non-vacuous proof, and specifications and mutations measure faithfulness, fault detection, and formal-core coverage.
  1. Compare models and agents: Single-shot and agentic generation are evaluated with fixed RTL, tools, and budgets, retaining per-module metrics.

1. 预处理层级 RTL： 固定 BaseJump STL commit，展开依赖、参数和实例关系，生成可独立形式验证的模块包。
  1. 合成参考断言： LLM 根据 RTL 与规格提出 SVA，formal tool 反馈编译、证明和空真结果，流程迭代修正后保存参考 artifact。
  1. 构造深层 bug 集： 对 28 个模块注入多类错误，保留正确/错误 RTL、自然语言规格和 mutation lineage。
  1. 运行六维验证： 编译检查语法，formal engine 检查非空证明，规格与 mutation 测试衡量忠实度、故障检测和 formal core 覆盖。
  1. 比较模型与 agent： 在相同 RTL、工具和预算下评测单轮与 agentic 生成，保存逐模块指标。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 12 models, the module-level compile rate is 67.1%. Among assertions in evaluable runs, 82.1% prove non-vacuously, yet they detect only 70.2% of eligible injected faults and cover 36.2% of the formal core. On 211 evaluable model–module entries in the deep subset, bug recall is 0.87 but precision is only 0.60, so 40% of predicted-buggy outcomes are false positives on correct RTL. The results show that provability is far from verification strength.

对 12 个模型的评测中，module-level compile rate 为 67.1%；可评测运行中的断言有 82.1% 非空证明，但只检测 70.2% 的 eligible injected faults，并覆盖 36.2% formal core。深层子集 211 个可评测 model–module 条目中，bug recall 为 0.87，但 precision 仅 0.60，意味着 40% 的预测 bug 在正确 RTL 上是假阳性。结果证明“可证明”远不等于“有验证强度”。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing SVA benchmarks often use compilation or proof success as one score. HierSVA links hierarchical data construction with evaluation and decomposes assertion quality into six non-equivalent dimensions, notably vacuity, mutation, and formal-core coverage. The novelty lies in the complete artifacts, bug pairs, and multidimensional verifier contract rather than a new LLM or formal solver.
现有 SVA benchmark 常把编译或 proof success 作为单一分数。HierSVA 的变化是把层级数据构建与评测绑定，并将断言质量拆成六个相互不等价的维度，特别加入 vacuity、mutation 和 formal core coverage。新意在完整 artifact、bug pair 和多维 verifier contract，而不是某个新的 LLM 或形式求解器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Single design source: The 342 modules come from BaseJump STL, limiting hardware styles and hierarchy patterns. Industrial SoC generalization requires new data.
  1. Reference-assertion dependence: LLM-in-the-loop reference SVA may omit true specifications, and formal tools verify only stated properties. Domain engineers must review faithfulness.
  1. Tool and parameter sensitivity: Formal cores, timeouts, and proofs depend on tool versions and constraints. Reproduction must pin solvers, parameters, and hardware resources.

1. 单一设计源： 342 模块来自 BaseJump STL，硬件风格和层级模式有限；泛化到工业 SoC 需新数据。
  1. 参考断言依赖： LLM-in-the-loop 参考 SVA 可能遗漏真实规格，formal tool 只能验证给定属性；需领域工程师审阅 faithfulness。
  1. 工具与参数敏感： formal core、超时和 proof 结果依赖工具版本与约束；复现必须锁定 solver、参数和硬件资源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. SVA-generation evaluation: Replace one compile/pass score with six metrics to detect vacuity, weak assertions, and false positives.
  1. Hardware-formal training: Turn RTL, specifications, reference SVA, and tool feedback into SFT or iterative-repair traces, retaining the 28 deep pairs for testing.
  1. Pipeline transfer: Run preprocessing–assertion generation–mutation–formal-core analysis on other RTL libraries while respecting source licences and manually confirming specifications.

1. SVA 生成评测： 使用六维指标代替单一 compile/pass，识别空真、弱断言和假阳性。
  1. 硬件形式训练： 将 RTL、规格、参考 SVA 和工具反馈整理为 SFT 或迭代修正轨迹；深层 28 组应保留为测试。
  1. 流程迁移： 对其他 RTL 库运行预处理—断言生成—mutation—formal core 流程，但需遵守源硬件许可并人工确认规格。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: A six-axis SVA benchmark with 342 hierarchical RTL modules and 28 deep bug pairs.
  1. Method hook: After proof, assertions must still be checked for vacuity, mutation detection, and formal-core coverage.
  1. Data hook: RTL, hierarchy, specifications, reference assertions, bug variants, and tool outputs are stored at depths 0–9.
  1. Evidence anchor: Although 82.1% of assertions prove non-vacuously, formal-core coverage is only 36.2% and precision only 0.60.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits hardware-formal data and evaluation after auditing specification faithfulness and solver versions.

1. 一句话定位： 342 个层级 RTL 模块、28 组深层 bug pair 与六维 SVA 验证 benchmark。
  1. 方法抓手： 形式证明后还必须检查空真、mutation detection 和 formal core coverage。
  1. 数据抓手： 保存 RTL、层级、规格、参考断言、bug variants 和工具输出，深度 0–9。
  1. 证据锚点： 82.1% 断言可非空证明，但 formal core 仅覆盖 36.2%，precision 仅 0.60。
  1. 复用决定： 适合硬件 formal 数据与评测；复用前审计规格忠实度和 solver 版本。
